items.title: Carl Allen interviewed by Monk Rowe, Atlanta, Georgia, January 4, 2013
items.q: And so I remember he put on Ramsey Lewis Trio, “The In Crowd,” and I was kind of like okay, well that’s kind of got a vibe to it.

ctx.x: I keep telling myself that. But we were raised just by my mother. My mother was a Gospel singer. And growing up, my mother, we were brought up in the church. And so when I was really, really young, I remember we were not allowed to listen to anything other than Gospel music in the house. Of course we did, and of course during certain times of the day when we knew it was time for her to come home from work, different people had watch out duties. And we were listening to Parliament Funkadelic, you know, all this…
